name: Select field
summary: Pick one value from a short, known set (or type free-entry tags) — a lightweight themed combobox field that embeds anywhere.
highlights: Pick one value from a short, known set
Opt-in search, server loading and free-entry tags
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-select> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. It is the LEAF counterpart to the composite Select: instead of a virtualised list, it is a styled combobox trigger over a themed listbox with the full keyboard contract built in. CSS lives in the shadow DOM, so both frameworks render byte-identical pixels; theming comes only from --aha-* tokens. Use it to pick one value from a short set and — crucially — to embed a select in a shadow-DOM row (aha-settings-list's control.type "select"), where the composite can't reach. The open dropdown is a fully THEMED role="listbox" popup (DS surface, radius 8, elevation shadow, 40px option rows with Select's #F7F7F7 hover row and brand-tint selected row) — not the browser's native <select> list; it's an accessible combobox (Arrow/Home/End, typeahead, Enter/Escape, outside-click). The open list sits in the browser top layer (Popover API, popover="manual"), placed with position:fixed from the control, so an overflow:hidden card, a transform or a z-index ancestor never clips or covers it; it opens above when there is more room there, stays 8px inside the viewport and follows scroll and resize. Without the Popover API it falls back to the same fixed placement.

spec.label: Size
spec.value: small 32 · default 40 · large 48; a settings panel uses default only: small and large are for other product surfaces (large also the audience field), and screen-lint --surface=settings rejects both

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: brand #E70E68 border + soft 2px ring (focus-ring-soft, 30% #E70E68); hover #E70E68 border

spec.label: Popup
spec.value: themed role=listbox — white surface, radius 8, 4px padding, 4px gap below the control, elevation shadow; option rows 40px (9px 12px, 14/22), radius 6, #F7F7F7 hover row and #E70E680D selected row with a #E70E68 semibold label (same as Select); Arrow/Home/End + typeahead + Escape; outside-click close

spec.label: Opt-in extras
spec.value: allow-clear: 16px system-x-circle, text-tertiary #8A8A8A, hover text-default; show-search: the text field sits over the value at the trigger's own font size, no-match row 14/22 text-tertiary; option description 12/18 text-secondary #4A4A4A under the label; popup-width match | content | length; loading: a small aha-spin replaces the caret and a 40px loading row (14/22 text-tertiary) stands in for the no-match row; option prefix (leading text such as a flag) and suffix (trailing 14/22 text-tertiary, such as a dial code); width="content": as wide as the longest option label; mode="tags": closable aha-tag chips (20px) and an inline field in the same 40 / 32 / 48 / 56 chrome, wrapping onto new rows

props.name: options
props.type: { label, value, disabled?, description?, title?, prefix?, suffix?, selectedLabel? }[]
props.desc: The selectable set — a JSON `options` attribute or an `.options` property. Optional per option: `disabled`, `description` (a second, smaller line under the label, 12/18 text-secondary), `title` (the row's native tooltip), `prefix` (leading text in the row, such as a flag emoji; hidden from assistive tech), `suffix` (trailing text in tertiary ink, such as a dial code; type-to-filter matches it too) and `selectedLabel` (what the closed trigger shows for this option instead of `label`, like antd optionLabelProp: "🇬🇧 +44" for a row reading "🇬🇧 United Kingdom +44")

props.name: value
props.desc: Selected value (controlled)

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Dimmed hint shown when no value is selected

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height 32 / 40 / 48. Never small or large in a settings panel (default only); large is the audience field's size (inside <aha-audience-field>)

props.name: status
props.desc: Validation border colour

props.name: error-message
props.desc: Message shown below the field while status is error: a 12px error glyph + the text at --aha-size-sm, rendered by an internal <aha-field-error icon> and linked to the trigger through aria-describedby (aria-invalid is set by status="error")

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: The accessible name, forwarded to the trigger; required when no visible label names the select

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Non-interactive, muted control

props.name: allow-clear
props.desc: Opt-in. Shows a system-x-circle clear button beside the caret while a value is set; a click, or Delete / Backspace on the closed trigger, empties the value and emits `change` and `clear` with {value:''}

props.name: clear-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the allow-clear button

props.name: show-search
props.desc: Opt-in. Type to filter: opening the popup (or typing on the closed trigger) turns the value area into a text field, an ARIA 1.2 combobox with aria-autocomplete="list". Options are filtered by label (case-insensitive contains); Arrow Up/Down move, Enter picks, Escape and Tab close. Emits `search` with {query}

props.name: empty-text
props.desc: The row shown when show-search filters out every option, or when filter="off" has no options to list

props.name: popup-width
props.desc: Opt-in popup width. `match` is exactly the control's width; `content` is as wide as the longest option with no control-width minimum (capped at 90vw); a number is pixels ("280") and any CSS length works ("20rem"). Unset keeps the default: at least the control's width, growing with content to 320px

props.name: loading
props.desc: Opt-in. A small aha-spin replaces the caret, the listbox is aria-busy, and while no option is listed the open popup shows `loading-text` instead of `empty-text`. The popup may open with no options while loading

props.name: loading-text
props.desc: The row shown in the open popup while `loading` is set and no option is listed

props.name: filter
props.desc: Opt-in, with show-search. `off` stops the list filtering by the typed text: every keystroke still emits `search` with {query}, so the host loads matching options from a server and sets `.options`. The popup opens with no options yet (showing `empty-text`, or `loading-text` while loading), and the picked option's label stays on the trigger after a later search replaces the options

props.name: width
props.desc: Opt-in. `content` sizes the control to its longest option (selectedLabel where set) or placeholder, so it does not jump as the value changes, and never wider than its container. Unset keeps --aha-field-width (240px)

props.name: mode
props.desc: Opt-in. `tags` turns the field into free-entry values: each value is a closable aha-tag chip before an inline text field, in the same field chrome (size, status, error-message, disabled, placeholder and aria-label apply). Typing a separator, Enter, a paste or leaving the field adds the text (trimmed; an exact duplicate is skipped); Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag; a chip's × removes it. There is no popup and `options` / `value` are not used

props.name: values
props.desc: mode="tags" only: the tags, as a `.values` array property or a JSON `values` attribute (controlled; setting it emits no event)

props.name: separators
props.desc: mode="tags" only: the characters that split typed or pasted text into tags; include a space to split on spaces. A pasted list also splits on new lines and tabs

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event; read e.detail.value. In mode="tags" it fires after every add or remove with e.detail.values (the whole list)

props.name: clear
props.desc: Composed event after allow-clear empties the value (value is '')

props.name: search
props.desc: Composed event on every keystroke in show-search mode; read e.detail.query. With filter="off" the list is not filtered, so this is how the host loads options from a server

props.name: open
props.desc: Reflects/controls the themed listbox popup being open (also toggled by click/keyboard); set it as a property so the list enters the top layer. aria-expanded stays in sync.

props.name: focus()
props.desc: host.focus() moves keyboard focus to the trigger (the shadow root delegates focus); in mode="tags" to the text field

whenToUse.when: one value from a short, known set, or a select inside a shadow-DOM surface like a settings row; add show-search when the list is long enough to scan by typing, allow-clear when empty is a valid answer, show-search with filter="off" and loading for options searched on a server, and mode="tags" for a free-entry list such as email recipients
several values picked from a list, a virtualised list, or option groups
2–5 mutually-exclusive options all worth showing at once

opinion.note: Pre-select the recommended default rather than leaving it empty. Keep option labels short and sentence case; keep product nouns — Q&A, Word cloud. This is the leaf half of the hybrid — reach for the composite Select the moment you need several values picked from a list, option groups or a virtualised list; type-to-filter is the opt-in show-search here, server search adds filter="off" and loading, and free-entry tags are mode="tags".
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the DS V3 select chrome measured against the Select component set on fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy: control 40 · radius 8 · 1px border #E3E3E3 (border-default), size axis small 32 / default 40 / large 48, brand #E70E68 focus border + soft 2px ring (focus-ring-soft, 30% #E70E68), #999999 placeholder, status error #1A1A1A / warning #1A1A1A. This is the LEAF form of that chrome (the composite Select carries the virtualised list and option groups). Token layer: white surface, rest border border-default #E3E3E3, hover border color-primary #E70E68, disabled bg-container-disabled #F1F1F1 / border-disabled #EBEBEB. a11y: a button role=combobox over a role=listbox with Arrow/Home/End, typeahead, Enter and Escape; the border/focus transition lives on the PERSISTENT trigger and the open fade on the persistent listbox, which repopulates in place. The trailing caret is summoned by name via <aha-icon name="system-caret-down">, never an inline glyph.

a11y.role: the trigger is a <button role="combobox" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded> controlling a themed role="listbox"; with show-search the open popup is driven from an <input role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list"> carrying aria-activedescendant
a11y.keyboard: Space / Enter / Arrow keys open; Arrow / Home / End move and typeahead jumps in the list; Enter picks; Escape closes without closing a surrounding drawer or modal; Tab closes. show-search: typing filters, Arrow Up/Down move, Enter picks. allow-clear: Delete / Backspace on the closed trigger clears. mode="tags": the text field is the tab stop, Enter or a separator adds a tag, Backspace in an empty field removes the last, each chip's × is a button
a11y.note: The clear button is tabindex=-1 so the field stays one tab stop; Delete / Backspace is its keyboard path, and it carries an aria-label (clear-label). While loading, the listbox is aria-busy. An option prefix is aria-hidden, so a flag emoji is not read before the country name. In mode="tags" the chips sit in a role="list".

codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. The only per-framework code is binding glue (React < 19 needs the ref wrapper to set `options` as a property; Vue binds `:options.prop` natively). The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

selfCheck.label: focus brand #E70E68 border + soft ring (persistent wrapper, animated)
combobox trigger + themed listbox with the full keyboard contract

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, so there is a single render (no per-framework roots). The probe is a placeholder (value-less) <aha-select>.
